mobbin:aa3e5e62-1c1e-4740-bd23-fba061be2.summary: Admin opens Workspace Scorecards empty state, starts Experience with required description, adds a 1–5 rating question, and opens the type menu (1–5 vs Yes/No) with Create enabled.
steps: Workspace Scorecards — No Scorecards + New Scorecard
Untitled Scorecard — required Description; Create disabled
Titled Experience — Description empty; Create disabled
Description Overall meeting experience — still Add Question only
Question filled — Did the meeting feel productive…
Type menu open — 1-5 Rating vs Yes / No
steal: Workspace-scoped library empty state No Scorecards (step 0).
Create stays disabled until description + question exist (steps 1–4).
Per-item type dropdown limited to 1–5 Rating or Yes/No (step 6).
Reusable workspace scorecard, not buried inside one meeting (sidebar Scorecards).
avoid: Only two response types (step 6) — too thin for clinical rubrics with multi-point competencies.
mobbin:aa3e5e62-1c1e-4740-bd23-fba061be2.fit: Extends cut-down checklist editor as a shared workspace rubric library (answers open question: checklist can live beside scenarios, not only inside SCE tabs).

mobbin:36d2c1e1-60fa-49f5-af4c-419966039.summary: Admin edits Workspace Meetings defaults: auto-record all meetings (member-as-organizer), access/link defaults, languages, recap recipients, and notification toggles, with Workspace updated toasts.
steps: Defaults — Don't auto record any meetings
Auto record all meetings + organizer checkbox; toast
Language multi-select open under access area
Full defaults — access, link, languages, recap section
Recap to team domain; comment notify On; duplication On
steal: Workspace auto record default dropdown over meeting-type categories + organizer-only checkbox (steps 0–1).
Admin lock icons on auto-record/access/link defaults (steps 0–4).
Meeting recap emails as separate recipient policy (steps 5–6).
Workspace updated toast after each change (steps 1, 3, 6).
avoid: Org-global Defaults for new workspace members (all steps) — not per-scenario-template automation like Essentials phase auto-record.
mobbin:36d2c1e1-60fa-49f5-af4c-419966039.fit: Adjacent to SCE scheduling auto-record/announcements: steal meeting-type filters + locks, but scope is workspace-global, not per-scenario.
